answer: Weight each identity by a convex function of how long its stake has stayed frozen: influence rises with the square of months held, so one account maturing across the long orbit of a comet outweighs many fresh clones. A farm splitting capital over N aliases restarts every clock at zero, and the squared curve collapses each toward a sliver of one aged stake, like saplings beside an old orchard. Pre-aging N aliases demands N full capitals frozen the whole window, so capital at risk scales with n. At settlement the ledger replays funding and a gale of slashing uproots weight built on forged age.
